actions.query: receipt:0002_action_search_files OR receipt:0003_action_search_files OR receipt:0006_action_search_files OR receipt:0014_action_search_files

contract.objective: Extract the full sequence of moves input in the referenced Zork YouTube video and write them one per line to /app/solution.txt.
required_behaviors: The file must contain the moves in order, one per line, matching the video transcript of player inputs.
The extraction should be based on the video contents, not guessed or fabricated.
known_invalid_patterns: Only creating a non-empty file without verifying the moves from the video.
Using unrelated text, partial transcripts, or inferred gameplay commands not supported by the video.
verification_plan: Obtain the video or a transcript/captions source for the referenced YouTube URL.
Extract only the player-input move lines from the transcript.
Write the moves to /app/solution.txt with one command per line.
Verify the file contents against the source transcript/video evidence.
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the source transcript/video contents.
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the extracted move list in order.

plan.current_focus: Locate prior receipts and workspace contents, then obtain a transcript/source for the YouTube video and extract player moves.
evidence_gaps: No confirmed access path to the video or transcript
next_steps: Inspect prior receipts for workspace listing details
Search workspace for helper scripts or cached artifacts
Acquire transcript/video source and extract moves
